resources.string: Dala amaphrofayili aqanjiwe esikhundleni sokusebenzisa izinombolo zomsebenzisi zoqapha umfutho wegazi. Khetha ukuthi isilinganiso esisha ngasinye esikabani. Kudingeka okungenani iphrofayela eyodwa ngenkathi lesi sici sivuliwe.
Khetha umsebenzisi okufanele athole izilinganiso ezilondoloziwe zalo msebenzisi. Ukususa umsebenzisi akususi izilinganiso noma kushintsha amakhophi asethunyelwe kwenye indawo.
Faka igama elingelona elingenalutho elinezinhlamvu ezingeqile kweziyi-100.
Ayikwazanga ukulondoloza lolu shintsho. Zama futhi.
Khetha umsebenzisi walesi silinganiso. Izilinganiso ezilindile ziboniswa kusukela kwezindala ukuya kwezintsha kakhulu. Ungabuya kamuva ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa yizo.
Izilinganiso ezintsha ezidinga umsebenzisi ngaphambi kokuthi zifakwe kufayela noma zithekeliswe.
%1$d izilinganiso zilondoloziwe futhi zilindele ukuthi ukhethe umsebenzisi. Thepha ukuze ubanikeze.
Ibhange lememori lokuqapha umfutho wegazi (1 noma 2)

Khetha owakho umsebenzisi obonakalayo ngaphambi kokunika amandla ukuthunyelwa kwe-Health Connect. Izilinganiso ezinikeziwe kuphela zalowo msebenzisi zizothunyelwa. Izilinganiso ezingabelwe zihlala ziyimfihlo uze ukhethe ukuthi ubani ozithathile.
Ukunika amandla ukuthunyelwa kufaka phakathi ukufundwa okulondoloziwe okufanelekile okwabelwa umsebenzisi okhethiwe. Izilinganiso ezilindele umsebenzisi azithunyelwa ngaphandle.

I-Health Connect imele umuntu oyedwa. Khetha umsebenzisi wakho kuphela. Uma ushintsha phakathi kwemodi yokuqapha umfutho wegazi we-memory bank kanye ne-virtual-user mode, kufanele ukhethe umsebenzisi wakho bese uvumela ukuthekelisa futhi.

Izilinganiso ezinganikezwanga kumsebenzisi zigcinwa kumugqa oyimfihlo wesikhashana, ngisho nakumodi yokudlula. Ayengezwa kumlando wokulinganisa, i-Health Connect noma okulayishiwe kwe-HTTP uze uwabele.

Umlando wokulinganisa okhona uyagcinwa. Izilinganiso ezilondolozwe ngaphambilini ngaphandle komsebenzisi obonakalayo ziboniswa njengezingabelwe. Ukuvala lesi sici kulondoloza kokubili izilinganiso ezilindile kanye namaphrofayela akho aqanjwe igama.
